question.text: Which commodity group describes this cargo item?

options.pharmaceutical: Medicines, vaccines, medical or diagnostic products
options.lithiumBattery: Lithium batteries or devices that contain them
options.chemical: Chemicals, reagents, cleaning or industrial substances

rules.title: NZ Cold chain at 8 °C or colder

expression.passWhen: every i in cargoItems satisfies (not(list contains(i.declaredCategories, "coldChain")) or i.temperatureRange.maxDeciCelsius <= 80)
